newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices extended gains in late Monday trade, thanks to a bank's projection of huge leaps in profits for Taiwan's top industrial conglomerate, Formosa Plastics group, brokers said.

With 40 minutes left, the weighted index was up 67.69 points or 1.03 percent at 6,663.79. Turnover was a modest T$46.4 billion. Plastic and chemical shares led the market to rise 2.66 percent, followed by textiles' 2.29 percent rise.
Brokers cautioned that recent record-high margin loans outstanding and institutional investors' window-dressing likely would prevent further sharp gains.
"The (Formosa Plastics) report is certainly a good news, but it's not good enough to ease all the conerns," said Oliver Fang, an analyst of National Securities.
